pdf.ocr.recognizeTitle: Reads the text of the pages without a text layer, on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
pdf.ocr.pageOffer: This page is an image without a text layer. Recognize its text to search it and to link board references.
pdf.ocr.documentOffer: No text layer: this is a scanned or raster PDF. Recognize its text to search it and to link board references.
pdf.ocr.linkRule: Recognized words are marked. Only exact board names read with a confidence of at least {floor}% become links.
pdf.ocr.cancelled: Text recognition stopped after {done} of {total} pages. Recognized pages stay searchable.
pdf.ocr.timeouts: Pages not recognized within the time limit: {pages}
pdf.ocr.unavailable: Text recognition is not available here: {message}
pdf.ocr.badgeTitle: Text recognized by OCR on this computer, average confidence {confidence}%
